items.details: Collect the armor and Python before entering the hold. Chainsaw attackers must not reach melee distance: establish space near a corner and switch targets promptly as each enemy falls. The Python is especially effective against the ordinary attackers. Keep ammunition and health for Vincenzo, who arrives with a firearm after the initial attackers. Defeat him, then actually leave the ship to finish.

Keep ammunition and health for Vincenzo, who arrives with a firearm after the initial attackers. Defeat him, then actually leave the ship to finish.
details_i18n.pt: Pegue o colete e a Python antes de entrar no porão. items.details: Keep Donald with you while intercepting the marked convoy. Damage Avery's vehicle enough to make him leave it, but do not destroy the occupied car: the plans can be lost in its explosion. Deal with the target after he is on foot, collect the dropped plans, then bring both Donald and the documents back to the marked destination. Use controlled attacks rather than firing explosives indiscriminately into the convoy.

details_i18n.en: Keep Donald with you while intercepting the marked convoy. Damage Avery's vehicle enough to make him leave it, but do not destroy the occupied car: the plans can be lost in its explosion. Deal with the target after he is on foot, collect the dropped plans, then bring both Donald and the documents back to the marked destination. Use controlled attacks rather than firing explosives indiscriminately into the convoy.
details_i18n.pt: Mantenha Donald com você ao interceptar o comboio marcado. Danifique o veículo de Avery até fazê-lo sair, mas não destrua o carro ocupado: os planos podem se perder na explosão. Enfrente o alvo depois que ele estiver a pé, recolha os documentos deixados e leve Donald e os planos de volta ao destino marcado. Prefira ataques controlados a explosivos disparados indiscriminadamente contra o comboio.

items.details: Keep the explosives van intact on the approach to Porter Road. Follow the temporary tunnel route and the placement markers rather than trying to use normal road navigation underground. The three-minute escape sequence begins after the first charge is placed. Continue through the remaining placements without backtracking. After the last charge, take the nearby Bobcat and follow the alternate exit, breaking through its gates instead of returning toward the blocked entrance.

details_i18n.en: Keep the explosives van intact on the approach to Porter Road. Follow the temporary tunnel route and the placement markers rather than trying to use normal road navigation underground. The three-minute escape sequence begins after the first charge is placed. Continue through the remaining placements without backtracking. After the last charge, take the nearby Bobcat and follow the alternate exit, breaking through its gates instead of returning toward the blocked entrance.
details_i18n.pt: Preserve a van de explosivos no caminho até Porter Road. Siga a rota temporária dos túneis e os marcadores de instalação, sem depender da navegação normal das ruas no subterrâneo. A sequência de fuga de três minutos começa após instalar a primeira carga. Prossiga pelas instalações restantes sem voltar pelo mesmo caminho. Após a última carga, pegue a Bobcat próxima e siga a saída alternativa, rompendo os portões em vez de retornar à entrada bloqueada.

items.details: Use the Noodleboy outside Punk Noodles and deliver by throwing food toward the marked customers. Each level ends only after returning to the restaurant. The bike carries six portions, so later levels require a refill during the route. Group nearby customers and plan the restaurant return rather than visiting the most distant marker first. Empty remaining portions if necessary before refilling, and check that each throw actually reaches its customer.

details_i18n.pt: Use a Noodleboy diante da Punk Noodles e entregue a comida arremessando-a para os clientes marcados. Cada nível só termina ao retornar ao restaurante. A moto leva seis porções; nos níveis finais será preciso reabastecer durante a rota. Agrupe clientes próximos e planeje o retorno ao restaurante, em vez de ir primeiro ao marcador mais distante. Se necessário, descarte as porções restantes antes de reabastecer e confira se cada lançamento chegou ao cliente.

items.details: Finish Frighteners to obtain the Avenging Angels outfit, then wear it and approach another Angel around Chinatown. Keep a recruited partner close: new targets depend on having an Angel nearby, and searching for a replacement wastes the running timer. A motorcycle with your partner as passenger can simplify travel. Finish level fifteen; the activity may continue afterward, but additional levels are not needed for this island's completion credit.

details_i18n.pt: Conclua Frighteners para obter a roupa Avenging Angels, vista-a e procure outro Angel nos arredores de Chinatown. Conclua o nível quinze; a atividade pode continuar depois, mas os níveis adicionais não são necessários para registrar esta ilha.

items.details: After The Portland Chainsaw Masquerade, wear Overalls and return to the same freighter between 18:00 and 05:00. Bring armor and a reliable firearm. One complete run contains five waves, but native completion requires finishing a second five-wave run too. Some opponents in the second run withstand a Python hit, so confirm each kill and preserve distance instead of assuming one shot always clears the threat.

details_i18n.en: After The Portland Chainsaw Masquerade, wear Overalls and return to the same freighter between 18:00 and 05:00. Bring armor and a reliable firearm. details_i18n.pt: Depois de The Portland Chainsaw Masquerade, vista Overalls e volte ao mesmo cargueiro entre 18:00 e 05:00. Leve colete e uma arma confiável. Cada tentativa completa tem cinco ondas, mas a conclusão nativa exige terminar também uma segunda sequência de cinco ondas. Alguns inimigos da segunda sequência resistem a um tiro de Python; confirme cada eliminação e mantenha distância, sem presumir que um disparo sempre resolve.

items.details: Find the tourist booth above the airport's southeastern stairs near the subway entrance. Drive each tourist to the marked landmark, then follow them on foot until they stop. Frame the tourist and the scenery and take the three requested photographs. Return them to the airport before their flight deadline. Completion requires twelve full trips, not twelve individual photographs; photo-quality bonuses are separate from completing the tour.

details_i18n.en: Find the tourist booth above the airport's southeastern stairs near the subway entrance. Drive each tourist to the marked landmark, then follow them on foot until they stop. Completion requires twelve full trips, not twelve individual photographs; photo-quality bonuses are separate from completing the tour.
details_i18n.pt: Procure o posto turístico acima das escadas no sudeste do aeroporto, perto da entrada do metrô. Leve cada turista ao ponto indicado e acompanhe-o a pé até ele parar. Enquadre o visitante com a paisagem e tire as três fotografias solicitadas. Leve-o de volta ao aeroporto antes do prazo do voo. É preciso concluir doze passeios completos, não apenas doze fotografias; os bônus pela qualidade das fotos são separados da conclusão do passeio.
